segments.t: In the kitchen, Nagiyev tastes Katya's tomato soup sphere and insists that Chef Barinov try it too, before Katya serves her next creation: frozen chocolate wind.
Хорошо! По вкусу просто томатный суп.
Вкусно! У нас молекулярное меню готово?
У вас уже и меню готово?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Хорошо! По вкусу просто томатный суп.
'Good! By taste it is simply tomato soup.' The meaning hinges on 'well' working together with 'soup' in spoken Russian.
'Vitya, try it.' In Russian, the idea of 'Vitya' flows naturally into 'taste' without extra filler words. Chef Barinov answers right away.
'I do not want to.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'I' before landing on 'want'.
'Try it! Do you like it?' In Russian, the idea of 'taste' flows naturally into 'pleases' without extra filler words.
'Moving on. Frozen chocolate wind.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'are going' before landing on 'wind'. Dmitry Nagiyev answers right away.
'Guys, chocolate wind!' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'guys' and 'chocolate' in a few short words.
'We are selling air!' In Russian, the idea of 'air' flows naturally into 'to sell' without extra filler words.
'I will try it, yes?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'yes'. Katya answers right away.
'Yes, of course.' The meaning hinges on 'yes' working together with 'of course' in spoken Russian.
Вкусно! У нас молекулярное меню готово?
'Delicious! Is our molecular menu ready?' In Russian, the idea of 'deliciously' flows naturally into 'ready' without extra filler words.
У вас уже и меню готово?
'You already have a menu ready too?' The meaning hinges on 'at' working together with 'ready' in spoken Russian. Dmitry Nagiyev answers right away.

'Yesterday we sat down, chatted, and approved the menu.' The plural past ending '-li' on the verb for 'to sit down' covers a group or the polite 'you'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Хорошо! По вкусу просто томатный суп.
Вкусно! У нас молекулярное меню готово?
У вас уже и меню готово?
And that finishes Scene Eleven. Listen for Nagiyev marveling that they can sell chocolate-flavored air for a thousand rubles a plate. Until next time!
